notes.title: Fixed all the bugs and flaws!
notes.content:
- Simplified 7th level.
- Fixed the death of a player on the last levels.
- Fixed bug with achievements at the 14th level.
- Now after completing the 15th level are displayed visually new achievements.
- Made easier the passage 10 and 12 levels!
- Fixed dimmer screen when the player dies.

Thank you players for your feedback! ːLike_Yellowː
